title: My grid-averaging bot on NZD pairs.
author: Hot-Mixture109
selftext:
I’ve been running a martingale/grid-style EA on AUDNZD and EURNZD. Mechanism is simple: it opens a position, and if price moves against it, it adds progressively larger positions at set intervals (0.04 → 0.05 → 0.06 lots etc.), pulling the average entry price closer to current price. One shared TP sits above the average, so when price reverses even slightly, the whole basket closes profitably — even though most of the individual entries were underwater along the way.

Attached are two live examples one basket that recovered a genuine -36 EUR drawdown into profit, and one that is still working through a -50 EUR drawdown as of today!
